fields.name: api_token
fields.help: Personal Awin API token (https://ui.awin.com/awin-api > 'Show my API token'), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. It is user-level: it reaches every advertiser account the user has at least viewer access to. Advertiser API access requires an Accelerate or Advanced plan.

me.note: GET /accounts: the user behind the token and the publisher/advertiser accounts it can access.

list_accounts.note: GET /accounts?type=advertiser: advertiser programmes the token's user can access (accountId, accountName = programme name, accountType, userRole). `id` is the advertiserId the report takes as account_id. No currency on this record.

get_report.note: GET /advertisers/{advertiserId}/reports/publisher?startDate&endDate&timezone=UTC&dateType=transaction: impressions, clicks and transactions per publisher over the window (publishers without activity are omitted). `spend` is totalComm (commission of approved + pending + bonus transactions; the Awin override is not included); pending/confirmed/declined splits are in raw. Awin has no campaigns, so `campaign_id` is not applied.

not_offered.list_campaigns: Awin programmes have no campaign objects; the only 'campaign' is a free-text click parameter (&campaign=) aggregated by GET /advertisers/{advertiserId}/reports/campaign (https://help.awin.com/apidocs/get-campaign-data-for-advertiser-report), which is a report, not a list of campaigns with ids.
not_offered.update_budget: No budget endpoint: the advertiser API covers transactions, performance reports, publishers, commission groups, offers, product feeds and conversions (https://help.awin.com/apidocs/for-advertisers); Awin is pay-per-commission.
not_offered.pause_resume: No programme or campaign status endpoint in the advertiser API (https://help.awin.com/apidocs/for-advertisers).

evidence: host api.awin.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (Let's Encrypt)
probe: 3/3 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route answered 401 too, so the host authenticates before routing
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 3/3 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
